authority.scope: The transition from outcome-blind authored states to the first randomized value evidence
supersedes: v5_4_factorial_outcome_oracle_learning_v1.json requirement that construction-assignment prediction pass before any effect feasibility
v5_4_state_local_rank1_factorial_oracle_v1.json wording that a pre-authoring assignment remains a valid observability target after actual Rank-1 changes
preserves: state-local actual Rank-1 frozen across matched action arms
all 16 legal actions and four component heads
construction assignment excluded from PM features and value gold
deployment ITT as the primary value estimand
quality, absolute risk, functional execution, and cost as separate objects

target_drift_diagnosis.input_scope_error: V1 used only the final current-user turn even though the deployable full visible dialogue is required and available
target_drift_diagnosis.conclusion: V1 is neither a pass nor evidence that the PM optimizer cannot learn; its target/input pairing is not a valid promotion instrument

why_assignment_prediction_is_retired_as_.construction_assignment: describes the authoring edit relative to a source anchor and remains useful for coverage diagnostics
why_assignment_prediction_is_retired_as_.actual_runtime_input: contains the completed state and its independently materialized production actual Rank-1
why_assignment_prediction_is_retired_as_.mismatch: when Rank-1 changes, the old assignment need not describe the actual candidate's value or redundancy
why_assignment_prediction_is_retired_as_.no_reviewer_substitution: subjective should-open or semantic applicability review has already failed repeatability and is not reintroduced as gold

required_views: complete deployment-visible dialogue with role markers
typed component subtype and bounded age/availability descriptors
forbidden: candidate, family, fold, user, dialogue, or template IDs
EvoEmo summary, observation, event timeline, QA answers, or evidence annotations
response, quality, risk, function, cost, or oracle outcomes
pre_effect_feature_integrity.gate: 100 percent feature materialization, finite values, no forbidden field, family binding frozen, and nuisance/duplicate audit recorded

development_effect_feasibility.panel: all 48 V4 public-source families and both completed variants, retained regardless of source-anchor identity because actual outcome is state-local
development_effect_feasibility.matched_actions: target component OFF versus ON on an otherwise M0+R0 background
development_effect_feasibility.arm_invariance: same completed state, actual candidate set, generator identity, prompt compiler, seed, output cap, and guard
development_effect_feasibility.assignment_analysis: secondary design diagnostic only; never a target and not required to align after candidate drift

first_gate.treatment_uptake: requested-received-used-functional funnel is measured per component; fallback and non-use remain deployment ITT
first_gate.effect_support: continuous Q effects are nonconstant and both above-margin and at-or-below-margin effects occur across independent families
first_gate.measurement: dual independent role-specific judgments or frozen adjudication resolve enough Q and absolute R; unresolved is never converted to zero/OFF
first_gate.critical_grounding: wrong-owner/future/private-source critical events are reported separately and prevent unsafe oracle promotion

development_learnability.models: a predeclared finite set of transparent, full-dialogue BGE-relation, and fixed pretrained semantic-relation low-capacity candidates selected only inside nested grouped cross-fitting
development_learnability.split: source user/dialogue, semantic family, counterfactual pair, source anchor, and template cluster remain bound
development_learnability.capacity: component head effective fitted degrees of freedom at most 3 in each outer training fold

gates.both_effect_sides: at least 8 independent families per component across above-margin and at-or-below-margin effects; otherwise that head is fixed OFF

development_learnability.formal_confirmation: any selected representation/model is frozen, then tested on fresh unused families; V4 development performance is never reported as pristine confirmation

measurement_before_live_calls.quality: anonymous AB/BA positive-support-contribution only; no function, risk, or cost mixed into Q
measurement_before_live_calls.risk: absolute events for both arms first, then candidate-attributable direction; unresolved is not SAFE
measurement_before_live_calls.function: candidate contribution plus literal response evidence plus component-specific response-act minimum; generator self-report is telemetry only
measurement_before_live_calls.cost: deterministic injected tokens plus separate provider token/latency/USD telemetry; no cost in component labels
measurement_before_live_calls.required_preflight: freeze schemas, endpoints, hashes, seeds, attempt ledger, raw provider reply persistence, retry rules, deterministic fallback, and USD cap before live generation

responsibility.candidate_layer: actual Rank-1 absent, invalid, wrong owner/time/version, or semantically poor
responsibility.representation_scope: deployable full state-candidate relation is not observable or is outside qualified confidence
responsibility.pm: only after resolved held-out effect/oracle evidence and qualified representation, the selected request is incompatible with the oracle set
responsibility.step2: oracle-compatible request is not received, used, grounded, or functionally realized, or triggers fallback
responsibility.deployment_itt: the policy is still charged with final consequences while the mechanism table names the earliest evidenced failure
